items.text: Emeka Egbuka listed OUT (concussion/foot) on ETR Sunday injury board for Week 8; Schefter confirms ruled out vs Falcons.
items.why: Foot injury after clearing concussion; confirmed by team/Schefter.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; check Bucs WR depth for volume.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining TB WRs/TEs.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder) per ETR board and Schefter full OUT list for Sunday.
items.opportunity: More opportunity for remaining TEN pass-catchers.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee); Levitan notes unique role so no clean replacement but 3-6 extra targets available; Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Knee; Broncos official/Schefter confirm OUT vs Chiefs.
items.implication: Broncos backfield/ receiving targets shift; monitor Waddle status.
items.opportunity: 3-6 more targets open; potential for Dobbins/Coleman snap/carry bump.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks OUT (ankle); Barkley has no designation and is IN/playing.
items.why: Hamstring for Smith (missed practices); ankle for Wicks; Eagles report/Schefter/Rap confirm; Barkley clear.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets to Goedert/others; Barkley full go despite prior hamstring/back.
items.opportunity: WR vacuum benefits TE/other WRs; reverse any prior Barkley sit concerns.

items.text: Lamar Jackson IN/no designation (ankle); expected to play; small docks on rushing per Levitan; Rap confirms back.
items.why: No final report designation; official clear; feels pain but bearable.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; Flowers WR5 boost.
items.opportunity: Full QB1 usage with mild rush dock possible.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) again; Levitan notes cryptic tweets/trade rumors and was close last week; Allen IN.
items.why: Quad; limited practice; Hall cryptic post; rumors.
items.implication: GTD; if out Braelon Allen elevates.
items.opportunity: Monitor for Allen handcuff/role expansion if inactive.

items.text: After two-TD outing, try to sell Quinshon Judkins; role hit with Sampson back (season-low snaps/targets last week); ETR clip explains.
items.why: Passing-game role diminished (3% target share, 51% snaps) with Sampson return; prior 13.6% share without him.
items.implication: Sell-high after spike; less upside ROS.
items.opportunity: Majority touches remain but reduced receiving work.

items.text: Taken AJ Brown (knee) out of projections as of now along with Egbuka/Tate/Spears; fallout visible in ETR projs. ETR board later had Q but reply notes multi-week out talk.
items.why: Knee; missed practices; Levitan removed from projs.
items.implication: Patriots WR targets to others; contingency plans needed.
items.opportunity: Volume to remaining NE pass catchers/Henderson if healthy.
items.conflict: ETR board still Q; official Q per reports but trending negative.

items.text: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route of strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 carries inside-5 and 13 targets in two games since suspension. Efficiency bonus if it comes.
items.implication: Sustainable RB1 value independent of pure efficiency.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE; production lacking and Chiefs allowed just one WR TD all season (to JSN); also Q (chest) with Harvey out.
items.why: Tough matchup (1 WR TD allowed) + recent production + chest Q.
items.implication: Sit if possible; risky even if active.
items.conflict: Harvey OUT could free some targets if Waddle plays.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE as WR5 this week; Lamar expected back unlocks him in potential track-meet vs Bills.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share with full QB.

items.text: RB LOVES: Derrick Henry (RB6 @BUF), Chase Brown (RB8 vs TEN), Josh Jacobs (RB11 vs CAR). HATES: Saquon Barkley (RB20 @WSH), Tony Pollard (RB21 @CIN), Omarion Hampton (RB34 @LAR).
items.why: Loves vs soft run Ds/history/TD luck/role; hates vs usage concerns/underdog/role lack (Barkley clear but wary).
items.implication: Prioritize Henry/Brown/Jacobs starts; fade or lower Barkley/Hampton/Pollard.
items.conflict: Barkley fully cleared/IN per reports yet still HATE on usage.

items.text: Brian Thomas Jr. dropped to Konata Mumpfield/Troy Franklin tier in Wk 8 projections despite 87-1282-10 rookie year; 20 games later.
items.why: Current projection tier collapse from rookie production.

items.text: Colston Loveland averaging 30% target share and 19.2 PPG (top-5 TE both weeks) in 2 games since Caleb Williams return; leads utilization.
items.implication: Strong TE1 play; sustain if Williams healthy.
items.opportunity: High route/target share in CHI offense.
